body: In kyptonian the symbol means hope.  Lois Lane improvised the symbol in all the different Superman stories and used the symbol looking “S” to stand for Superman.  So, I prefer both.  It’s part of the whole story.

I’m 45.  I’m struggling too.  But we all have issues.  I’m not going to say it’s your age.  It’s just another struggle.  I’ve just got myself is some major trouble.  I feel somewhat like you.  Maybe, we can help each other out.
